summary: Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 phn16-71 with Intel Core i7-13700HX RPL processor, Kingston DDR5-4800 (2x16 GB) RAM, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, and Windows 11 Pro 25H2, experiencing crashes when playing games with charger connected.
detected_fault: Potential conflicts between the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU and other system components, possibly related to undervolting or driver issues.
suggested_solution: Perform a thorough system reset, check for BIOS updates, run stress tests (e.g., Prime95, FurMark), and investigate potential hardware conflicts.
